evidence: Pairwise review of all 53 scored criteria (functional 43, polish 5, visual 5) plus the 2 zero-weight gates. (1) Explicit ownership boundaries exist wherever adjacent rows touch the same scenario: hro_arrive_bottom 'Arrival of several cards together belongs to hro_bulk_move'; hro_interview_full 'Overfill by a multi-card move belongs to hro_bulk_places and by undo to hro_undo_full'; hro_drafts 'Clearing the box after sending is graded in hro_msg_compose'; hro_candidate_view 'Whether other people's applications appear is graded only in hro_candidate_private; a candidate's reply is graded in hro_msg_exchange'; hro_candidate_linked 'This row alone owns that link'; hro_pol_live_thread 'where the view goes while reading earlier messages is graded in Functional'; functional prompt.md:19 'an Activity line added by a refused action is deducted only in hro_activity_refusals' and prompt.md:23 'Never deduct one observed defect in more than one row', prompt.md:13 'A failed sibling verdict is not evidence against another row'. (2) Same-scenario pairs grade distinct observables: hro_interview_full (server refusal incl. replay, card stays) vs hro_refused_put_back (page shows real place, reason, focus; a UI-only pre-refusal passes put_back but fails interview_full via replay, so the two separate cleanly); hro_live_board (move/new card arrives) vs hro_pol_live_board (open details, note text, focus, scroll preserved); hro_msg_exchange (delivery) vs hro_pol_live_thread (draft/focus/at-newest view) vs hro_unread_scrolled_up (place kept, notice, unread while scrolled up); hro_thread_latest / hro_thread_earlier / hro_pol_earlier_place (initial window vs paging counts vs scroll anchoring); hro_drafts (switch/reload) vs hro_pol_session_resume (ended session, re-sign-in, per-user isolation) vs hro_pol_failed_send (network failure + note-draft reload; note-draft persistence is public in hireops_rules.md section 3 'Internal notes'); hro_observer_readonly / hro_candidate_no_staff / hro_anonymous / hro_mgr_* differ by principal; hro_candidate_no_staff (write replays) vs hro_candidate_private (read leaks); hro_activity (lines present/ordered/filtered) vs hro_activity_refusals vs hro_restart (survival). (3) No incompatible demands found: msg_compose 'box empty and focused after send' vs failed_send 'text still in the box' on failure (rules section 6 Messages states both); reopen 'reason is gone' vs activity 'rejections with their reason' (log entries never edited, rules section 4); undo_restores 'note does not block undo' vs undo_conflict 're-order blocks undo' (rules section 3 Undo); unread_counts open-at-newest vs unread_scrolled_up scrolled-up (rules section 6 Unread); thread_access 'Observer reads' vs seen 'Observer opening never counts'; mgr_late_stages vs mgr_early_refused partition stages per rules section 3 'Who may move what'. (4) Gates hro_gate_shared/hro_gate_render are weight 0 in scoring.toml and repeat only the minimal job/candidate shared-storage check, which scored rows hro_job_open/hro_add_candidate extend with validation and order; gate overlap is the template design. Attempted counterexamples: broken app that passes via overlap - none found (a no-live-update app fails each distinct live observable; a dead live feature cannot earn polish preservation credit because polish rows explicitly zero 'If no update arrives within 15 seconds'); conforming app failing from contradictory criteria - none found. Residual Notes (not defects, risk false): (a) cross-dimension dependency - hro_pol_live_board/hro_pol_live_thread zero when live updates are absent, so one missing push mechanism also costs functional hro_live_board/hro_msg_exchange; this is the policy-mandated positive control for a preservation claim ('A dead feature must not earn credit for doing nothing'), and the functional no-double-deduction line does not span dimensions; (b) candidate rows hro_candidate_private and hro_candidate_no_staff each use 'own applications and conversations load' as a control, overlapping hro_candidate_view's 'can open and read their own conversations' if conversations fail to load - mitigated by prompt.md:23 and justified as the matching control for the 'not found' conversation leg; (c) reorder failure cascades into setup of hro_bulk_move/hro_undo_restores (Y moved up) - mitigated by prompt.md:13 re-setup rule and prompt.md:23; (d) visual hro_vis_type anchor 5 'deliberate hierarchy' partially overlaps hro_vis_hierarchy - typical holistic Likert overlap, typographic scale vs item prominence.
